notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-3ef53464fcdf, DOI 10.1038/s41598-023-48804-z, PMCID PMC10719357. Curated from stored Europe PMC full-text evidence for Benchmarking DNA isolation methods for marine metagenomics.
source_text: Shotgun sequencing libraries were prepared from 300-500 ng of starting DNA using MGIEasy Universal DNA Library Prep Set (MGI Tech), following the manufacturer's instructions. DNA libraries were further circularized and sequenced by a paired end sequencing using DNBSEQ-G400 with the High-throughput Sequencing Set PE100 following the manufacturer's instructions (MGI Tech). The concentration of the prepared libraries was measured using Qubit Flex (Life Technologies) with the dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
